interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility paint to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the road and to naturally slow traffic speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance, improve sightlines by preventing parking at the corner, and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone or planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement physical traffic calming measures like speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points or intersections to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential area.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees and planting strips to create a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the concrete walkway to remove trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance
interventions.description: Ensure a minimum clear path of travel by relocating utility poles or widening the sidewalk to accommodate both infrastructure and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to alert drivers to pedestrian activity.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Zone Enforcement
interventions.description: Establish and enforce a clear walking zone to ensure that trash bins and other utilities do not obstruct the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical speed control measures to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.
